# Security & Multi-Tenant Data Isolation Checklist: Identity and User Accounts

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, clarity, and consistency of security, authentication, and multi-tenant data isolation requirements prior to implementation.  
**Created**: 2026-09-07  
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md)  

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.  
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.  
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.  

---

## 1. Authentication & Credential Policy Requirements

- [ ] CHK001 Are password complexity requirements specified with exact minimum and maximum length bounds? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK002 Does the specification define whether special characters, numbers, or uppercase letters are mandatory, or is length the sole constraint? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Are anti-enumeration requirements specified for failed login attempts so the system does not disclose whether an email is registered? [Security, Spec §US1 Scenario 4]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the email enumeration protection requirement explicitly extended to the password reset request flow? [Security, Spec §FR-017, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK005 Are rate-limiting or anti-abuse requirements defined to mitigate credential stuffing and rapid repeated submissions? [Completeness, Gap, Spec Edge Cases]

---

## 2. Third-Party Identity & Account Linking Requirements

- [ ] CHK006 Are the exact conditions for automatically linking a Google account to an existing email/password account explicitly documented? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK007 Does the specification state what happens if an unverified third-party identity email collides with an existing account? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK008 Are failure and cancellation handling requirements defined when a user aborts or declines the third-party Google consent dialog? [Coverage, Spec §US3 Scenario 3]

---

## 3. Session Lifecycle & Token Storage Requirements

- [ ] CHK009 Is the session expiration policy quantified with an exact idle duration threshold and sliding renewal behavior? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, SC-006]
- [ ] CHK010 Does the specification define requirements for preserving in-flight user answers when a session expires during contract questionnaire drafting? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK011 Are concurrent multi-tab session termination requirements documented when a user logs out in another browser tab? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK012 Are cookie security attributes (`HttpOnly`, `Secure`, `SameSite`) documented in the technical requirements for session token persistence? [Completeness, Plan §Technical Context, Research §2]

---

## 4. Access Control & Route Protection Requirements

- [ ] CHK013 Are all protected application routes (`/dashboard`, `/questionnaire`) comprehensively enumerated in the specification? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the redirection and return URL preservation behavior clearly specified for unauthenticated access attempts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, SC-004]
- [ ] CHK015 Does the specification define boundary requirements preventing redirection loops if an unauthenticated user accesses an auth callback route directly? [Edge Case, Gap]

---

## 5. Multi-Tenant Data Isolation & RLS Requirements

- [ ] CHK016 Are contract generation ownership requirements documented such that each record is permanently bound to a unique user identifier? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK017 Are authorization failure requirements specified when an authenticated user attempts to access or resume another user's contract generation? [Coverage, Spec §US5 Scenario 4, FR-014]
- [ ] CHK018 Is database-level tenant isolation (Postgres Row Level Security) explicitly required to prevent application-layer bypass? [Completeness, Plan §Constitution Check, Data Model §2.2]

---

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially (CHK001–CHK018) for easy reference
